score.rationale: The proposal is exceptionally well-defined for a spike, clearly articulating its core purpose: to de-risk a future development pattern by proving an end-to-end slice with real code. The 'Why' section establishes a specific, measurable goal (proving evaluation gates catch regressions) that directly addresses a critical project risk. The scope is meticulously time-boxed and broken down into explicit functional requirements (FRs) and project deliverables (PDs), which double as granular, testable acceptance criteria. It demonstrates high technical feasibility by identifying key architectural components (Kibana Workflow, Agent Builder), calling out specific risks (engine limitations, model flakiness) with corresponding mitigation plans, and isolating the work in a dedicated worktree. While linkage to other artifacts is strong internally (FRs, PDs, As), it could be slightly enhanced with more explicit external links (e.g., to the feature epic or specific JIRA tickets), but the overall traceability from intent to implementation is excellent.
